judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation and has critical correctness bugs in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`. Despite adding `ajv` v8 to `package.json`, the candidate wrote `registry.ts` using Ajv v6 APIs (`import Ajv from 'ajv'` default import under NodeNext ESM and `e.dataPath` instead of `e.instancePath`), which causes `npm run typecheck`/`npm run build` to fail and causes the field-path acceptance test to fail because `e.dataPath` is undefined in Ajv v8. Furthermore, several acceptance criteria were left incomplete: `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts` were not updated at all, and the `CHANGELOG.md` entry only describes registration-time compilation rather than `execute` validation. In tests, `registry.test.ts` is missing the required tests for extra properties passing through, dynamic schema updates across calls, static compilation caching, and unknown tool throws, while the orchestrator loop test was placed in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file instead of `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
